DISCREPANCIES_FOUND_AND_HANDLED: The sample freeze on disk at WT/lanes/frame-review-provenance-v1/review/claude-v1/review-freeze.json is STILL THE OLD FORMAT (keys: actual_model_selection, reviewer_kind, verdict, files only) and its raw-final-message.txt has NO === SEAL === block. The lead's message said that freeze was sealed with the new tool; it was not. Join v2 is written against the TOOL (authoritative), and would REFUSE that old-format sample (fail-closed) -- correct. A freeze produced by the current seal_claude_review.py with a SEAL block is required.

The lead's message said review-freeze.json records `raw_final_message_is_verbatim_independent_final_message:true`. In the actual tool that flag lives in review.json['sealed_by'], NOT the freeze top level. Join v2 reads it from review.json sealed_by (content-bound via the freeze's files['review.json'] sha256). Flagged for the reviewer to confirm the intended location.

R1_INDEPENDENCE_CONTENT_BINDING.what: The join RE-DERIVES from bytes (never trusting a boolean) that raw-final-message.txt -- the reviewer's verbatim independent final message -- carries a === SEAL === block whose cited section hashes equal the on-disk sha256 of REVIEW.md and checks.json, and (for the lead-re-serialized review.json) of either the on-disk review.json OR its raw emitted section (the exact dual form the sealer verifies). It further requires: freeze.reviewer_cited_section_sha256 == the SEAL sections; freeze.seal_verified is True; review.json sealed_by asserts raw_final_message_is_verbatim_independent_final_message==True; and it BINDS the task-output pin (no longer inert) by requiring freeze.source_task_output_sha256 == the pinned task-output sha256 == review.json sealed_by.source_task_output_sha256, plus freeze.reviewer_agent_id == supplied id == sealed_by.reviewer_agent_id, plus the existing agent-<id> filename binding. This mirrors the GPT form's rollout_join:741-743 (independent rollout final message must cite the sealed review hashes), so a lead cannot self-author a review that passes.

R2_COMPLETED_AT.what: Requires a non-empty freeze.completed_at AND requires it to equal the SEAL block's completed_at (the reviewer's own sealed completion time, verified by the sealer -- consistent with R1, no longer a bare lead-sealed field). It is bound as review_completed_at and used as the Claude-branch ordering lower bound in validate_adoption_observation (observation must follow review completion and precede adoption). Fail-closed if absent.

R3_FORM_AWARE_SIDECARS.what: For reviewer_kind=='claude-subagent' the sidecar check keeps checks.json REQUIRED (compared by sha256+bytes+normalized mode, since the sealer records mode as the string '0600') and SKIPS bound-inputs.json and tool-topology.json (GPT-era sidecars the 3-file Claude roster does not seal; pin() would otherwise raise FileNotFoundError and crash adopt/frame_admitted). The GPT form is UNCHANGED (full-pin equality over all three sidecars).

required_changes_implemented.MODE_NOTE_optional_addressed: The disclosed mode-representation note is addressed via _mode_int, which normalizes the sealer's octal string '0600' to the int stat.S_IMODE returns.
